Butter Nut Balls
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 12:12am

Ingredients




1 stick butter
1 cup flour
2 teaspoons sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 cup finely chopped pecans
Powdered sugar

Preparation

1 Cut butter and flour together until pea size crumbs or smaller. Cut in sugar and vanilla. Add nuts and mix by hand. Form into 1 inch balls. Bake on greased cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes at 325 degrees. (Do not burn bottom of cookies.) Roll in powdered sugar while partly cooled.
